name: Super Video Player – play your videos with playlists and subtitles
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Play your self-hosted videos in a fast, responsive HTML5 player with playlists, subtitles, and live streaming – no code required.

Super Video Player | Documentation | Pricing | Support | Demo | Video Tutorial

Why Super Video Player?

Trusted by 3000+ websites worldwide, Super Video Player is a modern, lightweight WordPress HTML5 video player plugin that lets you embed self-hosted MP4, OGG, HLS (.m3u8), and MPEG-DASH (.mpd) videos anywhere on your website. Create responsive video players using Gutenberg blocks or shortcodes – no coding required.

Whether you’re building an online course, membership site, portfolio, documentation website, product showcase, or business website, Super Video Player delivers fast, responsive, and accessible video playback across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. It works with both the Gutenberg and Classic editors, is accessibility ready, and stays lightweight so your pages load fast.

Free Features

  • Modern HTML5 Video Player: Display self-hosted videos in a clean, responsive, lightweight player compatible with all modern browsers.
  • MP4, OGG, HLS & DASH Support: Play self-hosted MP4, OGG, HLS (.m3u8), and MPEG-DASH (.mpd) videos from a single player.
  • Live Streaming Support: Stream HLS (.m3u8) and MPEG-DASH (.mpd) videos with smooth HTML5 playback.
  • Gutenberg Block: Insert and configure video players directly from the WordPress Block Editor.
  • Shortcode Support: Embed players anywhere – posts, pages, widgets, and theme templates.
  • Responsive Design: Automatically adapts to desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Picture-in-Picture (PiP): Let visitors keep watching while browsing other pages or tabs.
  • Multiple Subtitle Files: Add VTT subtitle files in multiple languages for better accessibility and localization.
  • Custom Caption Styling: Customize caption appearance to match your website design.
  • Accessibility Ready: Built with accessibility best practices, including screen reader support.
  • Unlimited Video Players: Create and display as many players as you need.
  • Cross-Browser Compatibility: Works smoothly in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and other modern browsers.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Optimized for a smooth video playback experience.

Pro Version

Upgrade to Super Video Player Pro to create a professional video experience for online courses, memberships, businesses, portfolios, and media websites:

  • Video Playlists: Organize multiple videos into playlists with Default, Horizontal, Vertical, and Grid layouts.
  • Multiple Video Quality Options: Offer several resolutions so visitors can match the quality to their connection.
  • Multiple Player Layouts: Choose from professionally designed layouts to match your website’s style.
  • Advanced Player Controls: Show or hide Play/Pause, Volume, Progress Bar, Playback Speed, Captions, Fullscreen, Download, and Picture-in-Picture.
  • Video Title & Description: Display customizable titles and descriptions above or below the player.
  • Initial Volume Control: Set the default playback volume for every video.
  • Custom Seek Time: Define how many seconds users skip with keyboard shortcuts or controls.
  • Click to Play: Play or pause by clicking anywhere on the player.
  • Continuous Playlist Playback: Automatically play the next video for a seamless viewing experience.
  • Social Share Button: Let visitors share videos on their favorite social platforms.
  • Advanced Styling Options: Customize fonts, colors, alignment, and the appearance of titles, descriptions, and player elements.
  • Full Gutenberg Integration & Shortcode Compatibility: Use every Pro feature with blocks or shortcodes.

How to Use

  1. Install and activate Super Video Player.
  2. Go to Super Video Player → Add New.
  3. Upload or select your video.
  4. Configure the player settings.
  5. Copy the generated shortcode or insert the Gutenberg block.
  6. Publish your page and enjoy.

Prefer the block editor? Open any post or page, click the “+” button, search for Super Video Player, select your video, and publish.

Use Cases

  • Online Courses & LMS: Deliver lesson videos with playlists and subtitles.
  • Membership Websites: Serve self-hosted video content to your members.
  • Video Portfolios & Product Demos: Showcase your work in a polished player.
  • Tutorial, Documentation & Educational Sites: Embed how-to videos beside your content.
  • Business Websites, Blogs & Media Libraries: Present video anywhere on your site.

Loved by WordPress Users

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ So simple to use. Excellent!

❛❛A very neat and efficient way of playing self-hosted videos via WordPress.❜❜

–jonthanr

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Super Video Player”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to Super Video Player and create your first player.
  5. Copy the shortcode or use the Gutenberg block, then publish your page.

Manual installation:

  1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Super Video Player, create a player, and place its shortcode or block on any page.
sections.faq:
How do I install this plugin?

You can install it like any regular WordPress plugin – no different steps. Please see the Installation tab.

What video formats are supported?

Super Video Player supports MP4, OGG, HLS (.m3u8), and MPEG-DASH (.mpd).

Can I use self-hosted videos?

Yes. The plugin is designed for self-hosted HTML5 videos.

Does it support live streaming?

Yes. You can stream HLS (.m3u8) and MPEG-DASH (.mpd) videos with smooth HTML5 playback.

Can I create unlimited video players?

Yes. There are no limits on the number of players you can create.

Does it work with Gutenberg?

Yes. The plugin includes a dedicated Gutenberg block.

Can I use shortcodes?

Yes. Every player includes a shortcode that can be placed anywhere.

Can I use playlists?

Yes. Playlist functionality is available in the Pro version, with Default, Horizontal, Vertical, and Grid layouts.

Does it support subtitles?

Yes. You can add multiple VTT subtitle files and support multiple languages, with custom caption styling.

Does it support picture-in-picture?

Yes. Visitors can continue watching videos in a floating window while browsing other pages or tabs.

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the Super Video Player plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.
